item.title: How to Join Paths in Node.js
item.description: Joining file paths correctly is crucial for building Node.js applications that work across different operating systems. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve learned that string concatenation for paths leads to platform-specific bugs. The path.join() method provides a safe, cross-platform solution for combining path segments with the correct separators.
